tips.text: Crack relics for Ducats instead of buying them with Aya; 5 Ducats per Aya is a poor rate.
Crack relics in short repeatable fissures like Capture or Void Cascade.
Skip Excavation fissures; teammates drop the power cells before anyone has reactant.
Build it eventually for the Mastery, but do not spend your first 1,000 Ducats on it; Baro's Primed mods are the better first purchase.
